create_ProlificAgent: create a ProlificAgent instance from a MephistoDB, worker, and unit for Prolific crowd work
approve_ProlificAgent_work: approve the work done by a ProlificAgent on a specific unit with optional review note and bonus
reject_ProlificAgent_work: reject the work done by a ProlificAgent on a specific unit with an optional review note
soft_reject_ProlificAgent_work: soft reject a ProlificAgent work on Mephisto while approving the worker on Prolific
get_ProlificAgent_status: query the current status of a ProlificAgent relative to Prolific submission state
